local_hour_rotation_of_utc_hour.hypothesis: local_hour_(sin,cos) is an exact fixed +3h rotation of utc_hour_(sin,cos)

local_weekday_rotation_of_utc_weekday.hypothesis: local_weekday_(sin,cos) EQUALS utc_weekday_(sin,cos) exactly on rows that do not cross local midnight, and is exactly one weekday-step (2*pi/7) rotated forward on rows that do
local_weekday_rotation_of_utc_weekday.note: boundary rows (~3/24 of a day, UTC hour 21-24) are EXPECTED to be the one-day-forward case by construction (FEATURE_DICTIONARY.md:33); this is not a bug. n_unexplained>0 would indicate the hypothesis itself is wrong.

cold_user.note: encoded == normalizer(raw) for user_context features (masks pass through raw); a genuinely cold user is expected to collapse every column to a single constant (n_distinct<=1) both raw and encoded.

unknown_category.note: z(0) = (0-mean)/std is expected to be NONZERO here -- these features are not flag-gated to zero-after-normalization (they are true counts, not missing sentinels; FEATURE_DICTIONARY.md:45-47).
